statement: An e-resident's digital identity is a digital document issued to a foreign citizen, with the statutory objective of promoting the development of the Estonian economy, science, education or culture by opening Estonian e-services to the holder (Identity Documents Act § 20⁵). It can be used only to identify the holder and to give digital signatures in an electronic environment, which is what lets a foreign founder establish and run an Estonian company remotely through the e-Business Register and e-MTA.
caveat: e-Residency is a digital identity, not residency: the Police and Border Guard Board states it does not grant the right to reside in Estonia, and it is not a physical identity document or travel document, so living or working in Estonia still needs its own visa or residence permit. Since the 2025 amendments, applications from citizens of listed higher-risk countries are returned without review (§ 20⁶(1¹)), and the state fee is 150 euros.
